rows.name: cache
rows.caption: The user is already in KV, so getUser returns on line three, the second outlined line, and the note under D1 shows 0 reads.

rows.name: bucket
rows.caption: Each line is one run of allow() over the same ten requests, and the bright one is this case. A faster refill climbs back over one token sooner: at 4 tokens a second, R6 gets 429, and at 1 token a second, R6, R7 and R9 do.

rows.name: oauth
rows.caption: Another app on the device registered the client’s custom URI scheme, so the operating system handed it the redirect and its code (RFC 7636 §1). It has to guess the verifier; S256 of the guess does not match the bound challenge, so the server answers invalid_grant.
